expected_note: The W-2 as printed: box 6 1,810 is 2.50 below 1.45% of box 5 (1,812.50) and box 4 7,738 is 12 below 6.2% of box 3 (7,750), more than the whole-dollar rounding of a printed W-2, so the App refuses it for special payroll review (triage C-13a). scenario-13.json enters the statutory amounts instead.
